source_problem: Multiple OrderEntry objects can refer to the same Item. Per-entry equalities then constrain its one post-state stock against the same operation-entry stock, rather than summing the quantities.
approved_postconditions: For each Item referred to by this order's entries, its final stock equals its operation-entry stock plus the quantities of all this order's entries referring to that same Item.
Distinct entries referring to the same Item contribute separately, including equal quantities.
Different Items have their quantities accumulated separately.
fixture_identity_note: fixture_key/item_key in the examples name object identities in the test data; they do not add a model attribute or business precondition.
correction_scope: Replace alias-conflicting per-entry equalities with per-Item accumulation from the operation-entry stock. Preserve the existing-order guard, RECEIVED status and Boolean success result. Do not impose entry uniqueness, cascade effects or unrelated frame conditions.
